count-from-answer-leak.stimulus: Hear and see the start number only: a train car showing 3, then three empty cars.
count-from-answer-leak.response: Say (or tap in) the next three numbers in order.
count-from-answer-leak.visibility: The instruction, hint and narration never contain any of the answers; empty cars stay blank until the child fills them.
count-from-answer-leak.feedback: After the attempt, reveal the filled cars and count them together; a wrong car is corrected by re-counting from the start number.
count-from-answer-leak.score: All three continuations correct and in order; response time recorded silently. Any instruction that recites an answer fails generation validation.
count-from-answer-leak.liveCheck: Spoken continuation from three different starts including one in the teens

ordinal-to-tenth.stimulus: A line of up to ten distinct characters with the front announced; the tutor names a place from sixth to tenth.
ordinal-to-tenth.response: Say the name of the character in that place.
ordinal-to-tenth.visibility: No position labels on the line at the independent attempt; names are read aloud, never numbered.
ordinal-to-tenth.feedback: After a wrong name, count along the line from the front to the named place together, then ask again.
ordinal-to-tenth.score: Spoken name matches the character at the target place; at least three items per session with targets past fifth.
ordinal-to-tenth.liveCheck: Sixth, eighth and tenth asked over a ten-character line

k-story-problems-within-10.stimulus: A read-aloud join or separate story with numbers up to 10 on the scene.
k-story-problems-within-10.visibility: The story never states the unknown; no numeral menu; the scene shows the start set only.
k-story-problems-within-10.feedback: After the answer, act the story out on the scene and count the result together.
k-story-problems-within-10.score: Spoken number equals the result; results 6-10 present in the session; no zero results.
k-story-problems-within-10.liveCheck: Two stories with sums above 5 answered aloud

missing-difference-form.stimulus: A subtraction equation with one hidden number, alternating minuend and difference.
missing-difference-form.response: Say or pick the hidden number.
missing-difference-form.visibility: The full equation is never printed in the instruction; visual aids only in the aided phases.
missing-difference-form.feedback: After the attempt, show the equation complete and model counting back or up.
missing-difference-form.score: Hidden number correct; both hidden positions appear in one session; numbers within 10.
missing-difference-form.liveCheck: One missing minuend and one missing difference item answered

k-session-variety.stimulus: Each challenge in a session is a different problem: a different line and blank position, a different skip/start pair, a different pair of group sizes.
k-session-variety.response: Same as the underlying mode (fill the blank, tap the cells, say more/less/equal).
k-session-variety.score: Session validation rejects duplicate problems and single-position blanks before the child sees the session; two draws differ in most items.
k-session-variety.liveCheck: Two consecutive sessions of the same objective with visibly different problems

time-sequencer-k-prereader.stimulus: Three picture cards of daily events with one- or two-word labels and no clock times; the tutor names the cards.
time-sequencer-k-prereader.response: Drag the cards into order from first to last.
time-sequencer-k-prereader.visibility: No time anchors at K; no pre-labelled first slot at the independent attempt.
time-sequencer-k-prereader.feedback: After the attempt, replay the day in order with the pictures and say why each comes before the next.
time-sequencer-k-prereader.score: Order matches the only defensible sequence; no instruction or hint mentions reading a time.
time-sequencer-k-prereader.liveCheck: A K session driven without any printed time and without reading

calendar-today-framing.stimulus: A month calendar with one day marked as today; the tutor says today is marked.
calendar-today-framing.response: Say (or tap) the day of the week for today, then yesterday and tomorrow.
calendar-today-framing.visibility: The weekday name for the marked day is not highlighted in the header; options, if any, are read aloud.
calendar-today-framing.feedback: After the answer, trace up the column to the day header together.
calendar-today-framing.score: Weekday correct for the marked day; yesterday/tomorrow keyed relative to it.
calendar-today-framing.liveCheck: Today, yesterday and tomorrow answered from one marked calendar

k-draw-yield-variance.stimulus: Every category the objective names appears as a bin (hot, warm, cold); every session has at least three items.
k-draw-yield-variance.score: Generation validation fails a session missing a named bin or under three items; regenerate rather than ship the short session.
k-draw-yield-variance.liveCheck: Three consecutive draws with all named bins and three or more items each

count-to-100-k.stimulus: A short line of numbers starting anywhere up to 100, or a line with one wrong number.
count-to-100-k.response: Say the next numbers, or say which number is wrong.
count-to-100-k.visibility: The instruction never recites the continuation; the wrong number is not styled differently.
count-to-100-k.feedback: After the attempt, count the line aloud together and fix the wrong number.
count-to-100-k.score: Continuation correct; the wrong number is the only defensible pick.
count-to-100-k.liveCheck: Count on from 47 and from 89; spot the error in 23, 24, 26, 25

counting-extensions.stimulus: A set of objects that is rearranged, a large set from which N are requested, or a set with a hidden group.
counting-extensions.response: Tap and say how many after rearranging; tap exactly N; say the new total after one is removed or a pair added.
counting-extensions.visibility: No count badge during the independent attempt; the hidden group's count is said once, not printed.
counting-extensions.feedback: After the attempt, re-count together and name the principle (still the same; one fewer; two more).
counting-extensions.score: Spoken count and tap count agree with the set; give-me-N rejects over-taps; running totals correct after each change.
counting-extensions.liveCheck: Rearrange-and-recount, give me 7, and remove-one-say-how-many driven aloud

k-band-floor-reaudit.stimulus: The floored mode's own stimulus at K sizes (4-6 objects, 3 bins, 3 objects to order).
k-band-floor-reaudit.response: Spoken or touch-order answer as the ported mode already defines it.
k-band-floor-reaudit.visibility: No printed reading demand at K: labels are pictures or single sayable words read aloud by the tutor.
k-band-floor-reaudit.score: The reader-fit audit records the reading demand per mode; a lowered floor cites the audit and a K probe with usable items.
k-band-floor-reaudit.liveCheck: One K session per lowered mode driven with the tutor reading every label

k-data-recording.stimulus: A small set of countable objects or a class question, and an empty one-to-one pictograph or bar chart.
k-data-recording.response: Tap to add one icon per item; say how many; say which has most or least; say what the graph shows.
k-data-recording.visibility: No totals printed during the build; bar values hidden at the independent read.
k-data-recording.feedback: After the attempt, count the icons in each column together and compare heights.
k-data-recording.score: Icon counts match the data; most/least keyed in code from the data; the spoken explanation judged on meaning.
k-data-recording.liveCheck: Build a three-column pictograph from objects and answer most, least and how many aloud

length-lab-extensions.stimulus: One object with a unit tray (cubes, paper clips, hands); or the same object with two unit trays.
length-lab-extensions.response: Say an estimate first, then tile and count; or tile with both units and say which needed more.
length-lab-extensions.visibility: The estimate is captured before any tile is shown; the count is entered by the child.
length-lab-extensions.feedback: After measuring, compare the estimate with the count and name the unit size relationship.
length-lab-extensions.score: Tiles placed end to end without gaps; count correct; the two-unit comparison keyed in code.
length-lab-extensions.liveCheck: Estimate-then-measure with cubes and hands on one object

measure-sim-weight-capacity.stimulus: A pan balance with two pictured objects, or two containers and a cup of rice.
measure-sim-weight-capacity.response: Say a prediction, then place the objects or pour cups and say the count or which holds more.
measure-sim-weight-capacity.visibility: The balance is level and the containers empty before the prediction; nothing tips or fills until the child acts.
measure-sim-weight-capacity.feedback: After the test, name the outcome against the prediction (you said heavier, and it tipped that way).
measure-sim-weight-capacity.score: Prediction recorded before the test; tip direction and cup counts owned by code; spoken comparison judged against them.
measure-sim-weight-capacity.liveCheck: Predict-then-test on two balances and one pour-to-fill

shapes-in-the-world.stimulus: A drawing of one familiar object whose outline is one 2D shape (a clock, a door, a yield sign).
shapes-in-the-world.visibility: The object label never names the shape; no shape menu.
shapes-in-the-world.feedback: After a wrong name, trace the outline with the tutor and count sides together.
shapes-in-the-world.score: Spoken shape matches the code-derived shape; one defensible shape per object.
shapes-in-the-world.liveCheck: Five real-object items named aloud at varied sizes

pattern-k-gaps.stimulus: An AB pattern with one element missing in the middle, or a three-step sequence with the middle card blank.
pattern-k-gaps.response: Tap the token or card that fills the gap.
pattern-k-gaps.visibility: The gap is a plain empty slot; the surrounding pattern is complete on both sides.
pattern-k-gaps.feedback: After the attempt, read the pattern aloud together across the gap.
pattern-k-gaps.score: The fill is the only element consistent with the core (or the only defensible step).
pattern-k-gaps.liveCheck: Three missing-element and two missing-step items

analog-clock-k-parts.stimulus: A clock with one hand highlighted; a blank face; or a spoken whole-hour time with four faces.
analog-clock-k-parts.response: Say hour hand or minute hand; tap 1 through 12 in order; tap the face that shows the spoken time.
analog-clock-k-parts.visibility: Hands are unlabelled; the spoken time is never printed.
analog-clock-k-parts.feedback: After the attempt, point to the short and long hands and count the numbers together.
analog-clock-k-parts.score: Spoken hand name correct; taps in order 1-12; chosen face matches the spoken hour.
analog-clock-k-parts.liveCheck: Hand naming, a full count around the face, and three hear-a-time picks

calendar-days-k.stimulus: The tutor says a day of the week.
calendar-days-k.response: Say the next day, then the one after, in a chain.
calendar-days-k.visibility: No printed week strip during the independent attempt.
calendar-days-k.feedback: After a wrong day, sing or say the week together from Sunday and ask again.
calendar-days-k.score: Each spoken day is the correct successor; at least five judged turns from a random start.
calendar-days-k.liveCheck: A spoken chain from Wednesday through the following Monday

picture-thermometer.stimulus: A code-drawn thermometer with hot, warm and cold zones and a fill level in one zone.
picture-thermometer.response: Say hot, warm or cold (or tap the matching picture).
picture-thermometer.visibility: Zones are colours, not words, during the attempt.
picture-thermometer.feedback: After the attempt, name the zone and show a matching everyday picture.
picture-thermometer.score: The level sits unambiguously in one zone; spoken answer matches.

physical-observation.stimulus: Real materials in the classroom (water, sand, timer, balance, plants, bodies).
physical-observation.response: The teacher observes the physical action; where a reviewed screen half exists it runs as its own objective.
physical-observation.score: An observation flag on the draft curriculum row; the planner does not route the row to a Lumina primitive.
physical-observation.liveCheck: Draft edit, lineage check and publish for the flagged rows

sorting-station-k-draw-quality.stimulus: Four to six picture cards and two or three labelled trays, named aloud by the tutor.
sorting-station-k-draw-quality.response: The child SAYS which group each card belongs with, or yes/no against two criteria.
sorting-station-k-draw-quality.visibility: Nothing printed carries the answer; every card's emoji depicts the object its label names.
sorting-station-k-draw-quality.feedback: The tutor's scripted affirmation or 'My turn:' correction, spoken, one card at a time.
sorting-station-k-draw-quality.score: Every asked-for round is present and distinct; no card is unanswerable from its picture.
sorting-station-k-draw-quality.liveCheck: A K sort_variety session that rotates the rule across all five rounds

compare-groups-objective-window.stimulus: Two groups of objects whose counts both sit inside the range the objective names (1-5 or 6-10), with the tier's count gap.
compare-groups-objective-window.response: Say (or tap) more, fewer or the same.
compare-groups-objective-window.visibility: Count badges only at the easy tier; no printed totals at the independent attempt.
compare-groups-objective-window.feedback: After the attempt, draw the correspondence lines and count both groups together.
compare-groups-objective-window.score: Answer key derived from the two counts in code; generation validation rejects any count outside the objective window.
compare-groups-objective-window.liveCheck: One K session naming up to 5 and one naming 6-10, both answered aloud

slice7-draw-quality.stimulus: A pile of 6-20 objects with a spoken request for N (N varies across the session); a clock with one hand to name, five faces per session.
slice7-draw-quality.response: Tap exactly N; say hour hand or minute hand.
slice7-draw-quality.visibility: No count badge during the tap; no hand legend before the answer.
slice7-draw-quality.feedback: After the attempt, count the tapped set together; name the short and long hands.
slice7-draw-quality.score: Tap count equals N; spoken hand matches the highlighted one; session validation rejects repeated N and under-sized sessions.
slice7-draw-quality.liveCheck: One K give_me_n session with three distinct requests; one hand_name session of five items
